column1: # Batch 2 for #103: 25 papers DISJOINT from sample.paperoni.json.
# Fresh papers on purpose. Batch 1 saw each of the two admission-clause leaks
# exactly once in 25, which cannot distinguish a 4% rate from noise, and a
# re-run of the same papers cannot either.
# Three selectors are new, for what batch 1 could not measure:
#   protocol_name        -- does `Atari 100k` still come back as a source
#   non_learned_baseline -- does the model admission rule hold on solvers
#   repetition_factors   -- does the restructured field get used
# Intended for --platform openai, to test the instructions against a second
# model family rather than only the one that shaped them.
